name_reason: Fully compliant data_fd2_ global name. Prefix data_fd2_battle_ correct for a battle core table; 'summon_aura_ring' matches the 8-directional summon-spell aura sprite ring; '8slot' is the domain dimension (8 directional slots, confirmed by the 8-element REP MOVSD copy), not Ghidra address residue; 'row_multiplier' is accurate -- each entry is IMUL'd by row_stride (EBP) at 0x263b1 to form the vertical screen offset; '_table' reflects the int32[8] array type. No hex address suffix.
purpose: Per-slot row-stride multiplier for the 8 aura-ring sprites orbiting the caster during the summon-spell (zhao huan xi / 召喚系) cinematic; companion of the x-offset table @ 0x52420.
logic_summary: Read-only const table copied wholesale (REP MOVSD, 8 dwords) into a stack-local int[8] by fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring (@ 0x262EF). For each of the 8 ring slots the consumer computes the blit Y position as row_multiplier[slot] * framebuffer_row_stride + x_offset[slot] + 0x50 + origin_y (asm: MOV EDX,[ESP+EAX+0x20]; IMUL EDX,EBP; ...). Signed entries place slots above (negative) and below (positive) the ring center, forming the vertical spread of the 8-direction aura ring.
element_semantics: Signed integer vertical multiplier of the framebuffer row stride for ring slot i (i=0..7); negative lifts the slot above center, positive drops it below. Values = {-10,-24,-30,-24,-10,4,10,4}.
notes: Single xref to 0x52440 (and to interior 0x52444) is the READ from the REP MOVSD source at 0x26328 inside fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring; no writer anywhere and table lives in .object2 (read-only), confirming const. Ghidra data plate was null -> created via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (per src conclusion). Source comment (btltab2.c lines 12-26) already accurate and concise -> kept unchanged; btltab2.c not edited (only shard added). Ghidra datatype already int[8] matching int32[8].
